structure: Part 13, Dashboard. Read in full at commit c2078fb: the five DR2.1 dashboard views (dashboard-home.html 136 lines, the overall home at /design-release-2.1/; dashboard.html 297 lines, the notifications list at /live-animals and /germinal-products; dashboard-actions.html 114 lines at /actions; dashboard-changes.html 53 lines at /changes; dashboard-inspection.html 120 lines at /inspection), the notification card macro partials/design-release-2.1/dashboard-notification-card.html (69 lines), the seeded list app/data/dashboard-notifications.js (16 notifications, page size 8, four sort options), the Amend examples app/data/dashboard-notifications-testing3.js (4 notifications), and the routes.js ranges the partition names: 6478-6561 (arrival-date offsets by tab, getStaticDashboardNotifications), 7728-8048 (list, actions and inspection hrefs and pagination, the two categories, search matcher, list path, changes sections, delay filter, date format), 8264-8856 (view, copy, delete and amend hrefs, snapshot by reference, deleteNotification, arrival date, commodity and quantity labels, enrichDesignRelease2Notification, getDashboardNotificationList, results text, sort items), 9947-10325 (date range, type and status filter items, getDashboardViewModel, renderOverallDashboardPage, renderDashboardPage), 10479-10582 (actions, changes and inspection view models and renders) and the GET handlers for /, /live-animals, /germinal-products, /actions, /changes, /inspection and /dashboard. To say what the pages show it also looked, without claiming their own pages, at helpers outside the ranges: the version flags (routes.js:93, 312-345, 8202-8262), toDesignReleaseDashboardReference (400), mapStatusTextToReviewVariant (6456), getDashboardNotificationMetadata (6562), the missing-certificate and action-required message helpers (7468-7501), GERMINAL_QUANTITY_LABEL (83) and app/data/dashboard-notification-snapshots.js (the action-required snapshot has no documents). Since the earlier extract (commit 04a073b) the list page gained an applied Status filter (All statuses, Draft, Amend, Submitted, Past), a 'needs action' checkbox, an Apply filters button and a filter result line; its tabs became Submitted, Draft and Amend, and Past with descriptions; list cards show Submitted and Past tags; the card lost Copy as new and the Inspection field; germinal cards label quantity 'Quantity (unit/pieces)'; and the seeded dates are now worked out from today, with four Amend examples added. Claims run: overall home; routes and redirects; list page (back link, banner, heading, buttons, Summary cards, search, sort, filters, tabs, subheadings and descriptions, filter results, pagination, empty states); notification card (fields, status labels, error marker and message, View link, links not shown); actions, changes and inspection pages; and the seeded notifications as a fresh DR2.1 session shows them. Templates are part 14's.

claims.statement: Status text maps to variants: 'submitted' to submitted; 'submission complete', 'complete' or 'completed' to completed; 'submitted action required' or 'action required' to action required; anything else (including 'draft', 'new', 'in progress') to draft.

claims.statement: The status filter matches: 'Draft' drafts that are not being amended; 'Amend' notifications being amended; 'Submitted' submitted and action-required notifications; 'Past' completed notifications.
